reference.pathophysiology: Neutropenic and diabetic hosts grow thrush to candidaemia, halo-ring aspergillus, India-ink crypto meningitis and black-turbinate mucor; galactomannan with halos, crypto antigen with pressures, and broad aseptate hyphae steer amphotericin with voriconazole steps and exenterating surgery.
additionalDifferentials: TB versus bacterial versus malignant versus sarcoid by granulomas lobar PET and tightness
Aspergillus versus mucor by septae reverse-halo and diabetes
Crypto versus TB meningitis by ink ADA and pressures
additionalInvestigations: Halo reverse-halo CT with KOH India-ink
Cultures histology with HIV CD4 bands
